data.one_liner: Intercept and modify HTTP requests/responses using the http package.
data.what_it_does: Provides a wrapper to add interceptors for logging, authentication, and error handling around HTTP calls. Works with the Dart http client and compatible libraries like Chopper and Dio compatibility layer.
use_when: You need to add custom headers or logging to all HTTP requests
You want a simple way to handle errors centrally without modifying each call
You are using the http package or compatible clients and need interceptor support
avoid_when: You require interception for Image.network or other widgets that use dart:io HttpClient
You need a full-featured HTTP client with built‑in interceptors like Dio
You need code‑generation based API clients
strengths: Easy to integrate with existing http client code
Works with popular wrappers like Chopper and Retrofit compatibility layer
weaknesses: Limited to the http package ecosystem
Cannot intercept low‑level HttpClient used by Flutter's Image.network
Provides no code‑generation or advanced features like retry policies out of the box

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Full‑featured HTTP client with built‑in interceptor support and advanced features

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard HTTP client without extra abstraction, suitable if you don't need interception
